_note: Blind hand-written test set (2 per category). Written before the generator was revised and never used for training, threshold or temperature fitting. Same author as the generator, so it is not fully independent. Illustrative only.

examples.label: invoice
examples.text: Greenleaf Gardening Services. Customer: Mrs J. Adebayo, 4 Willow Close. Work carried out: hedge trimming, lawn mowing and green waste removal on two visits. Charge per visit 85.00. Total to pay 170.00 within 14 days. Bank details are shown below. Thank you for choosing Greenleaf.

examples.label: invoice
examples.text: Hosting account billing notice. Plan: Business Pro, billed annually. Period covered: 1 May to 30 April. Amount charged to card ending 4421: 239.88 including tax. Receipt number 88-1923. If you believe this charge is incorrect contact our billing team.

examples.label: contract
examples.text: Agreement for the supply of catering services. The supplier will provide lunches for up to 40 staff each weekday. The customer will pay the agreed price per meal, invoiced monthly. The supplier must hold food hygiene certification at all times. This agreement runs for one year and renews automatically unless cancelled in writing ninety days before renewal. Liability of the supplier is limited to the fees paid in the previous twelve months.

examples.label: contract
examples.text: Volunteer agreement. The organisation agrees to provide induction training, supervision and reimbursement of reasonable travel expenses. The volunteer agrees to follow safeguarding policies and keep information about service users confidential. This is not an employment contract and either party may end the arrangement at any time.

examples.label: resume
examples.text: Daniela Rossi. Chef de partie with experience in high-volume Italian and French kitchens. Experience: Chef de partie, Trattoria Luna (2021 to date) running the pasta section; Commis chef, Hotel Bellevue (2018-2021). Training: Level 3 Diploma in Professional Cookery. Food safety certified. Available for full-time roles.

examples.label: resume
examples.text: Personal statement: recent history graduate with strong research and writing skills, seeking an entry-level role in museum curation. Experience: visitor assistant at the city museum, archive volunteer cataloguing letters from the 1800s. Education: BA History, upper second class honours. Skills: archival research, public speaking, Microsoft Office.

examples.label: medical_report
examples.text: Pathology result. Specimen: skin biopsy from left forearm. Microscopy shows a basal cell carcinoma, nodular type, completely excised with clear margins of 2 mm. No perineural invasion identified. Recommend routine dermatology follow-up.

examples.label: medical_report
examples.text: Physiotherapy assessment. The patient reports lower back pain for three months after lifting a heavy box. Range of movement is reduced in flexion. Neurological examination normal. Plan: core strengthening exercises, posture advice and review in four weeks.

examples.label: financial_report
examples.text: Full-year trading update. Group revenue was 1.4 billion, an increase of 6 percent at constant currency. Adjusted operating profit rose to 182 million and free cash flow was strong. Net debt fell to 0.9 times EBITDA. The board proposes a final dividend of 14 pence per share.

examples.label: financial_report
examples.text: Quarterly cash flow statement summary. Cash generated from operations was 3.2 million, offset by capital expenditure of 2.1 million on new equipment. Loan repayments totalled 0.5 million. Closing cash balance was 4.7 million, compared with 4.1 million at the start of the quarter.

examples.label: research_paper
examples.text: Background: Antibiotic resistance is a growing threat to public health. Methods: We analysed 3,412 urine samples collected across six hospitals between 2018 and 2022 and measured resistance to five common antibiotics. Results: Resistance to ciprofloxacin increased significantly over the study period. Conclusions: Local prescribing guidelines should be reviewed.

examples.label: research_paper
examples.text: In this paper we present a new algorithm for scheduling deliveries with electric vans under battery constraints. We formulate the problem as a mixed integer program and propose a heuristic that finds near-optimal solutions in seconds. Experiments on real routing instances show cost reductions of 11 percent compared with standard approaches.

examples.label: meeting_minutes
examples.text: Notes of the project steering group. Present: project sponsor, project manager, finance lead, IT lead. The project manager reported that testing is two weeks behind schedule. The group agreed to release contingency budget for extra testers. Action: finance lead to confirm budget by Monday. Next meeting in a fortnight.

examples.label: meeting_minutes
examples.text: Annual general meeting of the Hillside Tennis Club. The chair welcomed members and gave her report on the season. The accounts were presented and accepted. Elections: a new treasurer was elected unopposed. Members voted to increase annual fees by five pounds. The meeting closed with thanks to the volunteers.

examples.label: legal_notice
examples.text: Notice to quit. To the tenant of Flat 2, 18 Market Street. Your landlord requires you to give up possession of the property on or before the date stated in this notice. If you do not leave, the landlord may apply to the court for a possession order. You should seek advice from a solicitor or advice centre.

examples.label: legal_notice
examples.text: Letter before claim. We write on behalf of our client in respect of the defective roof works carried out at their property. Our client requires you to remedy the defects or pay compensation of 7,500 within 21 days. If we do not receive a satisfactory response, court proceedings will be issued without further warning.
